content.text: The data shows F2Z01's cooling setpoint dropped ~1 C (24→23 / 25.7→24.6) starting mid-June, only during occupied hours, while all other F2 zones stayed at 24.0. A schedule change would shift the occupied pattern building-wide; a localized drop in a single zone is consistent with a local override or controller offset.
